title: 第11章 金丹境第12章 他编撰淮南子其学识足以比肩先秦诸子
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
国相默默地退了出去，将书房的门，轻轻带上。
屋内，再次恢复了寂静。
顾长青站起身，走到窗前，推开窗户。
窗外，是朗朗的夜空，星辰漫天。
他的目光，穿透了无尽的虚空，看到了那遥远的长安城。
“刘彻啊刘彻，我为你大汉，铸就了横扫四方的利刃。现在，只希望你，不要来打扰我的清修。”
他缓缓抬起手，掌心之中，一团青色的液态法力，缓缓流转。
筑基圆满。
三百二十七年的寿元。
一切，都已准备就绪。
“金丹大道，我来了。”
他的声音，在寂静的夜里，轻不可闻。
三日后，一个惊人的消息，从淮南王府传出，迅速席卷了整个寿春城。
淮南王刘安，薨了。
据说，是淮南王在炼制丹药时，丹炉炸裂，王爷为求仙丹，不顾劝阻，服下了一枚尚未炼成的丹药，结果当场中毒，暴毙而亡。
消息一出，整个淮南国，一片哗然。
百姓们自发地走上街头，为这位在他们心中声望极高的王爷，致以哀悼。
文人士子们，更是悲痛欲绝，纷纷写下悼文，感叹天妒英才，让一位足以与诸子百家先贤相媲美的大家，就此陨落。
整个寿春城，都笼罩在一片悲戚的氛围之中。
王府之内，更是哭声震天。

刘安的几位妻妾和子嗣，跪在灵堂前，哭得死去活来。
他们是真的伤心。
虽然这位王爷、父亲，平日里总是沉迷于那些神神叨叨的事情，对他们关心不多。
但他的存在，就是淮南王府这棵大树的根。
如今，根断了。
他们未来的命运，将会如何，谁也无法预料。
国相一身素服，须发皆白，在几天之内，苍老了十几岁。
他主持着整个葬礼，安排着各项事宜，有条不紊，却又处处透着深入骨髓的悲伤。
一些前来吊唁的官员，看着国相那悲痛欲绝的样子，心中也是暗自感叹。
都说淮南王与国相，名为君臣，实为知己。
如今王爷宾天，看国相这模样，怕是也要撑不了多久了。
没有人怀疑这场死亡的真实性。
因为，一切都太“合理”了。
淮南王喜好黄老，沉迷炼丹，这是天下皆知的事情。
历史上，因为误服丹药而死的王侯将相，不知凡几。
多一个淮南王刘安，实在是再正常不过了。
夜深人静。
content_en:
The Prime Minister retreated silently and gently closed the door to the study room.
In the house, silence returned again.
Gu Changqing stood up, walked to the window, and opened the window.
Outside the window, there is a bright night sky filled with stars.
His gaze penetrated the endless void and saw the distant Chang'an City.
"Liu Che, Liu Che, for you, a big man, I forged a sharp blade that can sweep in all directions. Now, I just hope that you will not disturb my Qing Xiu."
He slowly raised his hand, and in his palm, a ball of cyan liquid mana slowly flowed.
Foundation building is complete.
Three hundred and twenty-seven years of life.
Everything is ready.
"Jindan Avenue, here I come."
His voice was inaudible in the silent night.
Three days later, a shocking news came out from the Huainan Palace and quickly swept through the entire Shouchun City.
Liu An, King of Huainan, passed away.
It is said that when King Huainan was refining the elixir, the elixir furnace exploded. In order to seek the elixir, the prince ignored the dissuasion and drank an unfinished elixir. As a result, he was poisoned on the spot and died suddenly.
As soon as the news came out, the entire Huainan Kingdom was in an uproar.
People spontaneously took to the streets to pay their respects to the prince, who was highly respected in their hearts.
The literati were even more distraught and wrote eulogies one after another, lamenting that God was jealous of talents and allowed a great man who was comparable to the sages of hundreds of schools of thought to fall.
The entire Shouchun City was shrouded in an atmosphere of sadness.
Inside the palace, the sound of crying was even louder.
Several of Liu An's wives, concubines, and heirs knelt in front of the mourning hall, crying their hearts out.
They are really sad.
Although this prince and father are always obsessed with those boring things and don't care much about them.
But his existence is the root of the big tree of Huainan Palace.
Now, the roots are broken.
No one can predict what their future fate will be.
The Prime Minister was dressed in plain clothes, with white beard and hair. Within a few days, he had aged by more than ten years.
He presided over the entire funeral, arranging all the matters in an orderly manner, but with a deep-rooted sadness everywhere.
Some officials who came to express their condolences looked at the grief-stricken look of the Prime Minister and sighed secretly in their hearts.
It is said that the King of Huainan and the Prime Minister are called monarchs and ministers, but they are actually close friends.
Now Prince Bintian, looking at the state of the Prime Minister, may not be able to hold on for long.
No one doubts the authenticity of this death.
Because everything is too "reasonable".
It is known to all the world that King Huainan liked Huang Lao and was obsessed with alchemy.
In history, countless princes, generals and ministers have died because of accidentally taking elixirs.
It is absolutely normal to have one more Huainan King Liu An.
It's quiet at night.
